column1: # MEASURED on Apple M5 Max / 128 GB / macOS 26.4 / MLX 0.32.1 / mtplx 2.10.1,
# 2026-09-01. Metal's recommendedMaxWorkingSetSize on this machine is 110,100
# MiB; the pack wired 77.3 GB (79,155 MiB) at the `coding` settings.
# need_mib is the WEIGHTS footprint measured with `ps -o rss`, not weights plus
# KV cache -- the KV cache was not separately instrumented. It is therefore a
# floor, and the launcher's pre-flight against it is a warning, not a gate.
# The 29.8 GB n-gram table is streamed from SSD and is NOT resident, so it is
#   profile     ctx      measured decode   effective   ttft
#   long        131072   (same settings, effort raised -- not separately timed)
# `coding` is the only row with an end-to-end measured session behind it.
# `long` differs from it ONLY in reasoning effort, which changes token volume
# rather than rate; it is listed because it is useful, not because it was
coding|131072|3|low|32768|79155|default; the measured configuration -- 128k ctx, effort low
long|131072|3|medium|32768|79155|same sizing, more deliberation per turn; slower in wall-clock
